shortBulletSummary: Overall crypto market sentiment is neutral, with Bitcoin consolidating near $77K-$79K after August gains.
US spot Ethereum ETFs saw $10.95M net inflow Sept 1, marking 15 days without outflows.
Rising US-Iran tensions and oil prices increase Sept Fed rate hike odds to ~67%, pressuring crypto.
Escalating US-Iran conflict drives oil prices, fueling inflation fears and risk-off market sentiment.
Historically, September is a weak month for Bitcoin, despite recent positive performance.
